p: Kardia is software for finding jobs in the Swiss healthcare sector. Kardia is never the employer, does not hire anyone and does not broker employment relationships.
Use is free of charge for healthcare professionals.
You are responsible for the accuracy of your information. Credentials are reviewed by Kardia; you will be informed of the decision and the reasons for it.
Changes to verified information reset the status to «submitted».
Applications go directly to the employer. The employer sees original documents only if you share them for the specific application.
In the marketplace, your profile remains anonymous until you express «interest» in an offer.
Contributions must be factual and must not identify any individual. Kardia moderates them before publication.
Votes are stored without being linked to you and are shown only from five responses.
You can delete your account yourself at any time. Data is deleted in accordance with the privacy policy.

Kardia provides software for job advertisements, application management, offers and flex pools. Employment contracts are concluded exclusively between the employer and the healthcare professional; Kardia does not store any employment contracts.

Only organisations that are themselves the employer for the advertised position may post jobs. Registration with UID; matches in the SECO directory of placement and staff-leasing agencies are reviewed manually.
Information must be truthful and confirmed at least every 180 days; otherwise it is marked as outdated and ranked lower.
Reality check values may be commented on, but neither deleted nor hidden.
The prices on the pricing page apply. Invoices are payable within 30 days. No success fee per hire.
Application data may only be used to fill the position. An audit log is kept of all access to passport documents.
Kardia AG (working title), Zurich. Contact: datenschutz@kardia.ch.
Account data (email, language), qualification passport (diplomas, registry entries, experience, languages), applications and messages, search filters, technically necessary logs.
We store phone numbers, registry numbers and message texts encrypted (AES-256-GCM).
We process data only for job searches, applications and verification. In the marketplace we show only the district; for the commute, only a starting point rounded to about 150 m.
Ranking yes, automatic rejection never (no automated individual decision-making).

Hosted by Railway in the EU West region. Service providers: Anthropic (AI structuring, task-related texts only), Amazon SES (email), Stripe (employer payments), Sentry (error monitoring without personal data). Transfers to the USA only with appropriate safeguards.

Applications including messages: 6 months after the position is closed. Inactive accounts: after 24 months, with 30 days' prior notice. Passport documents: immediately when the credential is deleted. Raw AI texts: 30 days. Backups: 30 days on a rolling basis.
Data export as JSON with one click, self-service account deletion, information within 30 days.
We use only technically necessary cookies and no third-party tracking.
Kardia AG (working title, in formation), Zurich, Switzerland.
Email: kontakt@kardia.ch
Information in ward profiles comes from the employers; reality check values come from verified employees. Kardia checks plausibility but gives no guarantee of accuracy.
